# gh api failures print "HTTP <code>: <status text> (<url>)" (go-gh api client); transport
# failures print the Go net/http error text, and "error connecting to api.github.com" is gh's
# own wrapper for an unreachable host. Written 2026-11-09 for issue #561. If a live transient
# failure is ever observed, replace this payload with the captured bytes (see README practice).

HTTP 502: Bad Gateway (https://api.github.com/graphql)
